exam.title: Discipleship/Stewardship Class Exam
exam.instructions: Follow the same church exam flow, but submissions and results are now stored on the backend.

questions.prompt: Brother Peter has recently been appointed as a fellowship leader. However, despite his efforts, he struggles in his ministry relying solely on physical strength. According to the teaching on anointing, what is most likely missing in his ministry?
questions.explanation: Ministry effectiveness relies on the empowerment of the Holy Spirit, not just human effort.

options.label: The anointing of the Holy Spirit

questions.prompt: Many fellowship members are struggling academically, and some have started skipping meetings to focus on their studies. How should the leadership respond?
questions.explanation: The church should support holistic growth while teaching discipline and time management.

options.label: Organize academic support programs while emphasizing time management
Condemn them for prioritizing studies over God’s work
Reduce the number of fellowship meetings permanently
Ignore the issue since academics is a personal matter
